{{< video videos/density_maps.mp4 >}}

The 1UBQ map from PDBe, loaded as a density entity and styled with
     `Density Style ISO Surface`. The timeline tweens the contour threshold, in sigma of the
     map, and moves the node's built-in slice through the box.

     ProteinMotion crops the map around the helix; without a crop node the whole unit cell is
     shown, which is why the contour is busy.

After ProteinMotion's [`density_maps.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/density_maps.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/density_maps.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/density_maps.py"}
{{< include scripts/density_maps.py >}}
```
